development_scope: Public-source reproduction of previously observed private development results. Not prospective confirmation, student preregistration, held-out evaluation, field data, a novelty claim or an inversion experiment. All three methods and every original validation inverse case are retained.
direction_rule: unit negative sum of all 24 physical block gradients; zero if norm <= 1e-14
aggregation_rule: sum all 24 directional error bounds; unavailable if any block unavailable
unavailable_rule: Retain raw POD on unavailable frequencies, skip correction there, keep all paid work and descriptive aggregate gradients, null aggregate bound/upper. Any uncertified proposal requires exact fallback; this API does not execute recovery.
cost_rule: Cold independent POD and spectral engine for every case/method. Constructor offline DCT/projection setup, online cumulative/delta counters, shared historical teacher generation/basis fit, and separate offline fine validation are reported distinctly. No cross-method reuse.
numerical_scope: Exact-arithmetic inequalities evaluated in ordinary float64/complex128 with unverified PSD cancellation allowances. No formal roundoff enclosure, corrected-ROM autograd identity, or finite-step guarantee.
sampling_scope: Eight correlated slices from four previously used validation parents; descriptive equal-parent summaries only, no IID-eight claim.
